==================
For-in with identifier collection
==================

for (x in xs) doIt()

---

(source_file
  (for_in_statement
    variable: (identifier)
    value: (identifier)
    body: (expression_statement
      (method_invocation
        function: (identifier)
        arguments: (argument_list)))))

==================
For-in with list literal
==================

for (i in [1, 2, 3]) print(i)

---

(source_file
  (for_in_statement
    variable: (identifier)
    value: (list_literal
      (number_literal)
      (number_literal)
      (number_literal))
    body: (expression_statement
      (method_invocation
        function: (identifier)
        arguments: (argument_list (identifier))))))

==================

==================

---

  (for_in_statement
    variable: (identifier)
    value: (range_expression
      start: (number_literal)
      end: (identifier))
    body: (expression_statement
      (method_invocation
        function: (identifier)
        arguments: (argument_list (identifier))))))
